# Services

Core registers one DI service per provider listed in the `providers`
config, in this order. Resolve a service by name with
`$this->di->get('<name>')` or `$this-><name>` in an injectable class.
Replace a provider by setting its variable to your own provider class, or
by mapping the provider class to yours in the application `providers`
config; see [Configuration](../configuration.md#provider-overrides).

## Registered By Default

| Service | Provider | Override variable | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `application` | `PhalconKit\Provider\Application\ServiceProvider` | `PROVIDER_APPLICATION` | Registers the MVC application service. |
| `console` | `PhalconKit\Provider\Console\ServiceProvider` | `PROVIDER_CONSOLE` | Registers the CLI console service. |
| `webSocket` | `PhalconKit\Provider\WebSocket\ServiceProvider` | `PROVIDER_WEB_SOCKET` | Registers the WebSocket application service. |
| `debug` | `PhalconKit\Provider\Debug\ServiceProvider` | `PROVIDER_DEBUG` | Registers the debug helper service. |
| `env` | `PhalconKit\Provider\Env\ServiceProvider` | `PROVIDER_ENVIRONMENT` | Registers the environment helper service. |
| `router` | `PhalconKit\Provider\Router\ServiceProvider` | `PROVIDER_ROUTER` | Registers the mode-specific router service. |
| `dispatcher` | `PhalconKit\Provider\Dispatcher\ServiceProvider` | `PROVIDER_DISPATCHER` | Registers the mode-specific dispatcher and core dispatch listeners. |
| `request` | `PhalconKit\Provider\Request\ServiceProvider` | `PROVIDER_REQUEST` | Registers the HTTP request service. |
| `response` | `PhalconKit\Provider\Response\ServiceProvider` | `PROVIDER_RESPONSE` | Registers the HTTP response service. |
| `acl` | `PhalconKit\Provider\Acl\ServiceProvider` | `PROVIDER_ACL` | Registers the access-control service. |
| `security` | `PhalconKit\Provider\Security\ServiceProvider` | `PROVIDER_SECURITY` | Registers the password hashing and token security service. |
| `session` | `PhalconKit\Provider\Session\ServiceProvider` | `PROVIDER_SESSION` | Registers the session manager service. |

## Available, Not Registered By Default

Add these providers to your application `providers` config to register
them; most need an optional Composer package or PHP extension.

| Service | Provider | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `config` | `PhalconKit\Provider\Config\ServiceProvider` | Registers the framework configuration service. |
| `eventsManager` | `PhalconKit\Provider\EventsManager\ServiceProvider` | Registers the shared events manager service. |
